review_evidence: The eight-file project is explicitly a verification demonstration rather than an unrelated application.
Demo/Demo.lean and Demo/DemoOrig.lean prove functional-correctness facts for Fibonacci implementations; Demo/SmtDemo.lean contains corresponding SMT-assisted proofs and arithmetic examples.
Three files contain proposition declarations, including implementation-equivalence lemmas, so the source provides useful formal-verification examples.
summary: Reviewed verification_demo; retain the checked verification examples and supporting formal development.
